body:
## Summary

Implements **ADR-DMX-MCPPROF-001** (Accepted 2026-07-26) after operator phrase `ACCEPT AND EXECUTE TP-MCP-PROFILE-PROGRAM-001-R1` (supervisor packet `TP-MCP-PROFILE-PROGRAM-001-R1`).

Adds deterministic **profile-selected MCP tool plane**:

- Profiles in `mcp_catalog.yaml` (no implicit `all`)
- `profile_policy.py` inventory, digests, admin/write filters, fixed-path `repo-domain-read` contract
- CLI: `dopemux mcp profile list|show`, `doctor --profile`, `init --profile`, `generate --profile`
- Official GitHub read-only server entry + specialized Playwright/Semgrep/domain-read placement
- Unit tests for fail-closed negatives; docs + mcp-system PAL stdio truth

**Merge is NOT authorized** by this packet.

### Allowlist amendment (supervisor-approved)

- `schemas/mcp/fleet-catalog.schema.json` — `profiles` + enums for new servers
- `src/dopemux/mcp/default_catalog.yaml` — keep in sync with root catalog
- `mcp_tool_surfaces.json` — planned/seed keys for new servers (live capture unavailable)

### Acceptance evidence

- ADR status: **Accepted** with date 2026-07-26, operator phrase, unlocks `TP-DMX-MCPPROF-001`
- Proof: `proof/TP-DMX-MCPPROF-001/`
- Auditor: `PASS_WITH_RISKS` (second-pass invariant audit; formal AGY/Claude CLI not available)

### Profile digests (core)

| Profile | tools | profile_digest (prefix) |
|---|---:|---|
| core-code | 51 | `27f4d06e9c55…` |
| core-retrieval | 42 | `d1eba84d64a7…` |
| planning-audit | 15 | `e9e8f92d5c7d…` |
| ui-audit | 8 | `2afe4e86f8d5…` (domain-read blocked without contract) |

### Validation (local)

- profile unit tests: PASS
- mcp unit filter + arch fleet catalog: PASS
- ruff on touched modules: PASS
- mypy: FAIL (pre-existing noise on mcp_commands/fleet_catalog; recorded)
- `git diff --check`: PASS

### Residual risks

- GitHub tool names seeded for policy filters; refresh with live snapshot when available
- `repo-domain-read` blocked until repo ships fixed executable+manifest
- Agent-matrix generate remains for OpenCode/Codex parity; task profiles are the non-all plane

## Test plan

- [x] `uv run pytest -q tests/unit/test_mcp_profile_*.py`
- [x] `uv run pytest -q tests/arch/test_mcp_fleet_catalog_contract.py`
- [x] `dopemux mcp profile list|show core-code`
- [x] `dopemux mcp doctor --profile core-code|ui-audit`
- [ ] CI on PR head
